utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: So, Gus, do we have a clear schedule for the repair drive? I'm worried about overlapping with other neighborhood events.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ve got my calendar here—let’s make sure it doesn’t clash with the block party or anything else.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, let's compare dates. What's the block party date again?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Uli, have you heard anything new about when the repair drive is supposed to start? I'm trying to plan around the kids' school drop-offs.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Not yet, Faye. I checked the notice board this morning, but it was still blank.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I wish they'd post something soon. With my youngest having early dance practice, I need to know if I should shift my morning route.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Nell, what's this about the repair drive? I'm in a bit of a rush.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I think it's happening this Saturday at the community center—someone told me they need volunteers for fixing up old bikes and appliances.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Saturday? Alright, I can probably swing by for an hour or two in the morning.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got the tools ready for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Awesome, I've been rounding up volunteers. The more hands, the better — think we'll get a good turnout?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, should be a solid group.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: The repair drive schedule, do you know when it's coming through our street?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Not exactly sure, but I think I saw something about it being tomorrow afternoon. Did you get a flyer about it?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: No, I didn’t get a flyer. I just heard some folks talking near the mailboxes.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hey Cleo, I heard you mention something about a repair drive? Can you tell me more about what it's for?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, the repair drive is for collecting tools and materials to fix things around the neighborhood—broken fences, leaky faucets, that sort of thing.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That sounds like a great initiative. Do you have a list of specific items we should gather for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh hey Quinn, what was that about a repair drive? I keep forgetting everything lately.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, you know, the big neighborhood repair drive this Saturday! We're fixing up old bikes and tools together—I've been telling everyone about it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Bikes and tools, right! I think I have a rusty old wrench somewhere—should I bring that along?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Rosa, are you planning to join the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh yes, absolutely! I'm looking forward to it; it's a great way for neighbors to come together and help each other out.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That's wonderful, Rosa! I'm glad you're on board—I've got some tools ready, and I think we'll make a real difference.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Mina, did you see if the hardware store on Elm Street finally got those replacement hinges in? I've been watching their delivery truck schedule.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I didn't check today, but I did see Mr. Henderson unloading a box from their truck this morning. Might be worth a call.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Mr. Henderson? I'll swing by and ask him directly—he usually knows what's in those deliveries.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh hey Vik, heard there's a repair drive going on—need any help hauling stuff around?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I was just about to tell everyone—I'm planning to help haul some old furniture from Mrs. Chen's place to the repair tent later.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Count me in for that, I've got my truck parked out front and can help move the heavy pieces.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Repair drive? Sorry, I think I missed something—what's that about?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Repair drive? Are you sure that's a real thing, or did someone make that up?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Honestly, I'm not sure. I thought I heard someone mention it, but maybe I mixed it up with something else.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Eli, I heard you're organizing that repair drive—need a hand with anything?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Well, I appreciate the offer, Sam. I'm still sorting out the schedule, so maybe you could help with that.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I can help with the schedule. Let me grab my calendar and we can figure out the best times together.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: A repair drive, you say? I like a good plan. What's the schedule?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I was thinking we could start Saturday morning, say 9 AM, but we need to make sure we have enough tools and supplies first.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Saturday at 9 sounds good to me. I can help inventory what tools we have in my shed beforehand.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Kira, heard you're organizing the repair drive. How's that coming along?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, the repair drive? I don't recall signing up for that—are you sure you've got the right person?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, sorry, I must've mixed you up with someone else. My bad!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Cleo, heard there's a repair drive? What's that about?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, it's a community effort to gather tools and spare parts for fixing up broken things around the neighborhood. We're collecting donations at the old garage.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Gotcha, tools and parts at the garage. I might dig up an old drill or something—when's the deadline?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Leo! I'm so glad you stopped by—I'm putting together a list for the neighborhood repair drive and could really use your help.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure, what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great! I need someone to collect small appliances from neighbors who can't drop them off. Would you be up for that?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Mara, I heard you're organizing a repair drive. How can I help out?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks for offering, Sam! Could you help spread the word by putting up flyers around the neighborhood?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I'd be happy to put up flyers. Do you have them ready, or should I grab some from you?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Rey! Did you hear about the neighborhood repair drive this Saturday? We're fixing things up together!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, I hadn't heard. What kind of things are we fixing?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Anything from leaky faucets to broken fences! I'm helping organize, so I've got a list of projects already.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Did you see if the repair truck is still parked over by the Johnson's house? I thought it was supposed to move to the corner lot by noon.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: No, I haven't seen it yet. I've been inside most of the morning.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I'll step out and check the corner lot myself. Can't have that truck blocking the drive all day.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, Vik! I almost forgot—did you say the repair drive is this Saturday or Sunday? I wrote it down somewhere...

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: It's this Saturday, bright and early at 9 AM over at the community center. I keep repeating it to make sure nobody forgets!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Saturday, right, got it! I'll make sure to set three alarms this time so I don't show up on Sunday with my toolbox for nothing.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Noah, I heard about the repair drive you're organizing. How can I help get the word out?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the repair drive! Yeah, I keep forgetting to put up the flyers. If you could hand some out at the coffee shop, that'd be great.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely, I’m at that coffee shop every morning—I’ll make sure everyone sees them.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Gus, have you heard they’re organizing a repair drive this weekend? I think they’re collecting tools and old appliances to fix up.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I just saw a flyer about it down at the community center. I’ve got a couple spare wrenches and a drill I could donate.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that's great you’re donating! I heard they’re also looking for someone to help with transport—do you have a truck by any chance?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: The repair drive is happening this weekend, right? I want to make sure I have the right time before I mark it down.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: It's Saturday from 10am to 4pm. Are you planning to bring something to fix?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, Saturday 10 to 4. I have a wobbly chair I've been meaning to fix—do you think they'll have the tools for that?
